standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-se.npc: I never did get the chance to thank you properly for saving Kennith and myself.

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-se.player: Oh, don't be silly, it was nothing really.

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-se.npc: Play it down if you will. It was a truly brave thing you did.

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-se.player: I only did what anyone would have done in my position. I have to go now, take care.
